backlog.task: FEATURE: Fully implemented Customers module with FTS search, detailed view, and secure deletion (prevented if orders exist). Decoupled repositories via domain interfaces and improved Preview stability.
UX/UI: Optimized landing page gallery with 3D ring effect, typing animation for descriptions, and improved mouse/touch interaction (v1.0.9).

FIXED: Resolved persistent white keyboard issue on some devices (e.g., Samsung) by explicitly forcing dark signals in both XML styles (v27+) and Activity runtime via SystemBarStyle.dark. Ensured full alignment across variants.
FIXED: Fully aligned all variants (Full, Demo, Showcase) with theme coherence fixes. Eliminated initial white flash by defaulting splash background to Dark theme.
QUALITY: Resolved editor warnings, redundant qualifiers, and dependency locking mismatches across all variants.
QUALITY: Resolved editor warnings and Lint errors (Locale deprecations in tests, LocalContext usage, unused resources, etc.).
FEATURE: Added UI settings with Dark/Light theme toggle (default Dark). Synchronized system bars and keyboard theme.
LEGAL: Verifica accessibilità e pubblicazione HTTPS definitiva per Privacy Policy (inventoveritas.mine.nu).
PROCEDURAL: Pianificazione e avvio gruppo di test chiuso (20 tester per 14 giorni) per compliance Play Store account post-2023.
TECHNICAL: Configurazione finale Data Safety e questionari Play Console basati sui documenti tecnici aggiornati.
QUALITY: Test di regressione su hardware low-end (Android 10-12) per verificare fluidità UI dopo ottimizzazioni dispatcher.
MAINTENANCE: Updated dependencies (AppCompat 1.7.1, Material 1.14.0, Protobuf 4.35.1, Commons-Lang3 3.20.0, Ktlint 1.8.0) and verified project stability.
MAINTENANCE: Monitoraggio warning Gradle 10 (AGP 9.2.1) e warning Compose 'frameRate=NaN'.
